en_title: Henry Cavill's Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe Finally Gets a Meaningful Update as Games Workshop Makes Significant Amazon Announcements
cn_title: 亨利·卡维尔《战锤40K》宇宙迎进展
subtitle: 剧本即将启动
opus_summary: Games Workshop披露《战锤40K》影视进展：亚马逊请联美影业和迈克·弗拉纳根推进剧本，卡维尔继续参与。另有《秘密关卡》第二季新集及死亡守望动画。

paragraphs.en: Games Workshop has made a number of significant announcements on the Henry Cavill Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe, as well as new Amazon animations based on its tabletop games.
paragraphs.cn: Games Workshop就亨利·卡维尔参与的《战锤40,000》影视宇宙，以及基于其桌游推出的亚马逊新动画，发布了多项重要消息。

paragraphs.en: After concluding negotiations with Amazon to create Warhammer 40,000 movies and TV shows in December 2024, Games Workshop has now finally provided an update on the progress of the project. In a financial report, Games Workshop CEO Kevin Rountree said that Amazon had brought onboard United Artists (UA) and Mike Flannigan, who, having completed initial outlines, “should soon be moving on to script.”
paragraphs.cn: Games Workshop在2024年12月结束与亚马逊就制作《战锤40,000》电影和电视剧展开的谈判后，如今终于更新了项目进展。Games Workshop首席执行官Kevin Rountree在财报中表示，亚马逊已请来联美影业（UA）和迈克·弗拉纳根；双方完成初步大纲后，「应很快进入剧本阶段」。

paragraphs.en: Vertigo and Warhammer 40,000 superfan Henry Cavill “remain involved as they have been for some time,” Rountree added, which will come as some relief to those who took the radio silence around the project as a sign that Cavill may have exited his role as steward and star.
paragraphs.cn: Rountree还补充说，Vertigo和《战锤40,000》的超级粉丝亨利·卡维尔「仍像一段时间以来那样继续参与其中」。对于那些把项目长期沉默视为卡维尔可能已退出统筹者兼主演角色信号的人来说，这应会让他们松一口气。

paragraphs.en: What happens next? Well, it sounds like it will still be some time before we get firm details on the setting and characters, if work hasn't even begun on a script. And we don’t yet know if Flanagan’s work relates to a movie or a TV show. Rountree did say that “UA have been decisive and brought their renowned pace and quality to the project,” though, so hopefully news will start to pick up.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来会怎样？如果剧本工作尚未开始，关于故事设定和角色的确切细节看来还得等上一段时间。我们也尚不清楚弗拉纳根的工作对应的是电影还是电视剧。不过Rountree称，「UA行事果断，为项目带来了他们闻名的效率和品质」，希望相关消息会开始增多。

paragraphs.en: What does the decision to bring Flanagan in tell us about what to expect? He’s best known for horror, having created the Netflix shows The Haunting of Hill House, The Haunting of Bly Manor, and Midnight Mass, among others. He’s also behind the upcoming Amazon Prime Video series Carrie, and wrote the first draft of the script for the upcoming DC Universe film Clayface.
paragraphs.cn: 请来弗拉纳根这一决定预示了什么？他最为人熟知的是恐怖题材，曾创作Netflix剧集《鬼入侵》《鬼庄园》和《午夜弥撒》等。他也在负责即将推出的亚马逊Prime Video剧集Carrie，并为即将上映的DC宇宙电影《泥面人》写了剧本初稿。

paragraphs.en: So, it stands to reason that whatever this Warhammer 40,000 TV show or film is, it leans into horror. If that’s true it could be hugely exciting for fans. The grimdark 41st millennium is most famous for bombastic battles between Space Marines and terrifying aliens and demons, but Warhammer 40,000 has plenty about it that can be considered horror — even body horror, with the horrible Death Guard rotting themselves and everything around them.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，无论这部《战锤40,000》电视剧或电影最终为何种形式，合理推断它都会偏向恐怖风格。若真如此，对粉丝而言会非常令人期待。阴暗残酷的第41个千年最出名的是星际战士与可怕外星生物、恶魔之间声势浩大的战斗，但《战锤40,000》也有大量可被视为恐怖的元素，甚至包括身体恐怖：骇人的死亡守卫会让自己和周遭的一切一同腐烂。

paragraphs.en: Cavill, in a recent interview with Esquire , touched on the “complexity” and “trickiness” of adapting the Warhammer 40,000 IP. But, he insisted, he was loving the challenge. Bringing Warhammer to life "is a dream come true," Cavill said, "but it's different from what I've done before, in the sense I haven't had my hand on the tiller of things before. It's wonderful doing that. It is a tricky IP, and a very complex IP, and that's what I love about it. The challenges that come with putting this on the page in a way that is doing justice to that complexity, that trickiness, and that nuance, is a challenge I'm enjoying enormously."
paragraphs.cn: 卡维尔近日接受Esquire采访时谈到了改编《战锤40,000》IP的「复杂性」和「棘手之处」。但他坚持表示，自己很享受这项挑战。卡维尔说：「让《战锤》走进现实‘可谓梦想成真’，但它与我过去做的事不同，因为此前我从未亲自掌舵。能这样做非常棒。这个IP既棘手又极其复杂，而这正是我喜爱它的原因。如何将它呈现在纸面上，并真正尊重其复杂性、棘手之处和细微差别，所带来的挑战让我非常享受。」

paragraphs.en: When the Games Workshop / Amazon deal was announced, Cavill issued a statement on Instagram saying he’d been “working away in concept rooms, breaking down approaches to the enormity and magnificence of the Warhammer world."
paragraphs.cn: Games Workshop与亚马逊的协议公布时，卡维尔曾在Instagram发表声明，称自己一直「在概念创作室里工作，拆解如何呈现《战锤》世界的宏大与壮丽」。

paragraphs.en: He added: "together, we've been sifting through the plethora of incredible characters and poring over old tomes and texts. Our combined efforts have led us to a fantastic place to start our Universe, which has been agreed upon by those up on high at both Amazon and Games Workshop. That starting place shall, for now, remain a secret. Watch this space, though — more to come in time!"
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「我们一起梳理了大量出色角色，并仔细研读古老典籍和文本。我们的共同努力让我们找到了开启这个宇宙的绝佳起点，亚马逊和Games Workshop的高层都已同意这一方案。这个起点暂时仍将保密。不过请继续关注，之后会有更多消息！」

paragraphs.en: Who might Cavill play across the Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe? Talking to IGN in 2021, Cavill expressed interest in playing one of the Primarchs or Captain-Generals , who are high-ranking key characters from the Warhammer lore.
paragraphs.cn: 卡维尔可能会在《战锤40,000》影视宇宙中饰演谁？他在2021年接受IGN采访时曾表示，有兴趣扮演原体或禁军统领，这两者都是《战锤》设定中的高阶关键角色。

paragraphs.en: Does the Amazon project need to be more grounded than a big galactic epic? We’re left with scraps to mull over, such as recent comments from Dan Abnett about NDAs and upcoming books .
paragraphs.cn: 亚马逊的项目是否需要比宏大的银河史诗更贴近现实？我们目前只能从零星线索中揣摩，例如Dan Abnett近日谈及保密协议和即将推出书籍的评论。

paragraphs.en: The news doesn’t stop there, because Games Workshop also announced that it has almost completed an episode for Season 2 of Amazon’s animated anthology series, Secret Level, following the success of the Warhammer 40,000 episode in Season 1. This one, though, is set in the Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universe (fantasy). So don’t expect a follow-up to Titus’ adventures ahead of the release of Space Marine 3.
paragraphs.cn: 消息还不止这些。Games Workshop还宣布，在第一季《战锤40,000》篇章成功后，亚马逊动画选集《秘密关卡》第二季的一集已接近完成。不过这一集设定在奇幻风格的《战锤：西格玛时代》宇宙，所以在《星际战士3》发售前，不要期待会接续Titus的冒险。

paragraphs.en: Fear not, because Games Workshop announced it has begun work on a full animated Warhammer 40,000 series featuring the Deathwatch. This series will be written by John Orloff, with Blur again animating, and released through Amazon. “We can’t wait to see it!” Rountree said.
paragraphs.cn: 别担心，Games Workshop宣布已开始制作一部以死亡守望为主角的完整《战锤40,000》动画系列。该系列将由John Orloff编剧，继续由Blur负责动画制作，并通过亚马逊推出。Rountree说：「我们已经迫不及待想看到了！」
